rv.q: This is challenging, thoughtful theatre that asks us to consider not only what war does to people, but what we ask of them in the name of service, and how much of ourselves we can lose along the way.
The immersive, in-the-round production staged by David Cecsarini is one of the best San Diego theater productions of 2026, and it features one of this year's finest performances.

At one point, the dialogue discusses the meaning of an oxymoron, and you could definitely say 9 Circles is one, as it takes an awful subject matter and handles it fiercely well through masterful theatrical storytelling.
